title: Ending a Healthy Options Card Programme and Giving Up the Balance
content:
An allowance programme ends when the health plan enrollment that carried it ends, or when the member asks for it to be closed. These are the conditions on which a Ridgecrest Healthy Options Card programme is brought to an end.

**The authority to close.** The closure is recorded on an allowance service intake with the request action programme closure and an intake standing of recorded, awaiting the member's signature or under review, or the health plan enrollment that carried the allowance has already ended. The intake and its standing are read from the plan's own service intake records for the request concerned, before the programme is closed. Only the member may ask for the programme to be closed while their health plan continues, because the card and its balance are theirs to give up.

**The balance at closure.** *The following clause is no longer in force and has been superseded by the current basis:* "On the tiers that forfeit on disenrollment, whatever is still on the card when the programme closes is taken off in one entry on the closing day and is not paid out in cash, refunded or moved to another card."

**Purchases that straddle the closing day.** Purchases made before the closing day are honoured even where they settle after it, and a member who spent their allowance on the last day keeps what they bought.

**A member moving between Ridgecrest plans.** A member who is moving from one Ridgecrest health plan to another is told before they decide that the card ends with the old plan, so that they can spend the balance first.

**A closure recorded in error.** Where a closure was recorded in error the programme is opened again and the forfeited balance restored by a correcting load naming the forfeiture.

superseded_clauses: On the tiers that forfeit on disenrollment, whatever is still on the card when the programme closes is taken off in one entry on the closing day and is not paid out in cash, refunded or moved to another card.
